correctness.rationale: For κ,γ,T,r>0, the energy norm is nonexpansive under deterministic oscillator and zero-velocity resets; positive-probability reset-free blocks contract uniformly and give a unique invariant law. Conditional on the reset clock, laws from thermal Gaussian equilibrium are centered Gaussian with covariance bounded by equilibrium, justifying fourth moments. Generator on x^i v^j yields a closed 3-equation degree-2 and 5-equation degree-4 system. Solving gives alpha_X=6κr/D(r), alpha_V=r(r²+5γr+6γ²+6κ)/D with positive cubic D. Independently reconstructed these polynomial systems in SymPy and checked the exact closed forms. The derivative numerator 24γ³+32γκ−9γr²−2r³ is strictly decreasing from positive to negative, hence unique global positive maximizer; alpha_X vanishes both ends, alpha_V→1. No full Gaussian limit claimed.
